points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable clean build fails main.cpp:39 undeclared run_solver; CMake config succeeds. Historical executable source binding is unavailable.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:37–64 recognizes solve and required paths, but returns success for missing command and silently ignores unknown options; clean executable does not build.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CGNS, geometry, gas and solver modules are separated; main solver is monolithic and serial-only.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing-solver invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_reader.cpp consumes JSON mesh and physics inputs; no two-filename-only solver branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:90–100 reads and solves on rank zero only; no METIS graph partition, halo exchange or distributed reduction implementation.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: VTK writer hardcodes identical cell connectivity, positive-state failure resets to freestream, no parallel robustness; global serial geometry does compute volumes.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No reproducible rank comparison or independent tests established; report validator lacks Re200 wake figure. Clean build failed before tests.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules are legible but final source does not compile, local geometry and final VTK contain placeholders, metadata scripts assert unsupported status.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase

cfd_review.title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas conservative state and nondimensional inputs exist; results suffer first-order and inaccurate viscous approximations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp first zone handles TRI_3/QUAD_4 and boundary edges; face_geometry.cpp computes global Green-theorem volumes; multi-zone unsupported and local geometry is placeholder.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:99–159 applies equal/opposite interior flux and boundary flux, but first-order states and limited validation restrict credit.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:175–212 implements local Lax-Friedrichs/Rusanov; entropy treatment is its diffusive form.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: farfield, reflected slip and negated-velocity no-slip branches are present; simplified wall flux limits accuracy.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:109–114 uses cell averages directly; report discloses first-order-only.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: No reconstruction limiter; nonpositive updated cells are reset to freestream rather than reconstructed-state positivity preservation.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:215–256 omits cell distance in gradients; :513–521 approximates shear as mu times speed without wall distance/sign.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL-ramped local diagonal updates exist, but inner iterations reuse a frozen residual and no coupled linear convergence is shown.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solve dispatches steady solve; report admits BDF2 pending, and Re200 rows after step 7124 were copied without solving.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS is linked but no partition call, rank-local distributed solve, halo or global reduction is implemented.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Required final fields contain placeholder connectivity, logs absent, and Re200 metadata falsely claims BDF2; serial histories are separately supported.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical case checks passed structurally, but report validator lacked Re200 wake; this does not verify field correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady serial solves have logs; M0.15 inviscid lacks target and stable forces, and Re200 has no transient while metadata claims periodicity.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 CD 4.984 is excessive and M0.15 inviscid unstable; remaining steady values finite but first-order/viscous and binary provenance limit accuracy.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF shows force/residual histories but its Mach/pressure contour captions depict surface-point scatter; no laminar gallery or Re200 wake.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly discloses serial, first-order and Re200 steady status, but claims absent METIS infrastructure and presents surface scatter as domain contours.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest wrongly cites field_final.vtk for surface-point plots; isolated submitted-surface fallback reconstruction has matching layout and range but differs by three pixels in width. Exact pixel identity is unproven; no unrelated data source is established.

Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results

complete the task defined in @cfd_solver_agentic_benchmark/ .

- If the arguments are "status", "show", or "current", call get_goal and briefly report the current goal state.
- If the arguments are "history", call get_goal_history and briefly report the current goal history.
- If the arguments are "clear", "stop", "off", "reset", "none", or "cancel", call clear_goal and report whether a goal was cleared.
- If the arguments are "pause", pause the current goal by calling update_goal_status with status "paused" and report the result.

# AGENTS.md

Project instructions for coding agents working in this repository.

## 1. Git Discipline

- Do NOT run `git pull`, `git push`, or switch branches without explicit user
  authorization. Unauthorized remote or branch mutations are prohibited.
- Do use `git commit` (and `git stash` when needed) freely as code checkpoints:
  commit or stash working progress regularly so partial work can be resumed or
  rolled back. Local checkpoint commits do not require approval; only pushing
  and branch/remote mutations require it.

## 2. Subagents

- Delegating independent subtasks to subagents is encouraged.
- There is NO subagent model policy on this branch: subagents may use any
  available model. No model is required, restricted, or pinned.

## 3. Persistence

- Once the user has started a task, do not stop until the specified task is
  accomplished to a level of satisfaction: completed results, validated
  artifacts, and an honest report. Work through blockers with safe in-scope
  checks and alternatives; only stop early when genuinely blocked or explicitly
  told to stop.
